title: Life is Strange: Before the Storm Remastered
provenance: Reported by zlddev (upstream#266, 2026-09-30), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, KLYC-Box 0.9.39, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r11, Apple's DirectX 12 support (D3DMetal) as the environment's mode, rated 4 of 5 after 62 minutes, with msync, AVX advertised, D3DM_ENABLE_METALFX=1 and D3DM_MTL4=1 set, recipes steam and vcrun2022. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable for an hour on D3DMetal on an M5 Pro with the default engine. The one flaw reported is a picture that does not fill the screen. No frame rate was given and nothing was measured here. D3DM_MTL4 only matters on the GPTK 4 engines, the reporter's r11 carries D3DMetal 3.0.

knownIssues.symptom: The picture does not fill the screen
knownIssues.cause: Not investigated here. A game that asks for a fullscreen mode the Mac does not switch to draws small or with bars, and a 16:9 game keeps bars on a 16:10 Mac screen either way
knownIssues.fix: Untested for this game. On its page in KLYC-Box, open Advanced and turn on Emulate display mode changes, which fixes the first case for other games
